rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a low-cost place where travelers stay overnight.

example.english: We stayed in a hostel in Taipei this time; it was cheap and convenient.
example.traditional: 我哋今次去台北住旅舍，平又方便。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 heoi3 toi4 bak1 zyu6 leoi5 se2 ping4 jau6 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this when the hostel is specifically a youth hostel with dormitory-style accommodation.

example.english: A lot of young foreigners stay at this youth hostel.
example.traditional: 呢間青年旅舍有好多外國年輕人住。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 cing1 nin4 leoi5 se2 jau5 hou2 do1 ngoi6 gwok3 nin4 hing1 jan4 zyu6

rows.note: Use this for a shelter providing homeless people with a temporary bed and possibly food.

example.english: This hostel lets homeless people stay temporarily.
example.traditional: 呢間收容所畀無家可歸嘅人暫住。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 sau1 jung4 so2 bei2 mou4 gaa1 ho2 gwai1 ge3 jan4 zaam6 zyu6
